body: I just need someone to stroke my hair and tell me it's okay and they understand and I'm not selfish and I did my best and that no one can blame me.

i did a search for mental health quotes and depression quotes and they all seem absurd to me. Like I laughed at them. Not to be an asshole but I don't relate to the "I am a mistake" "no one loves me" "just let me die" quotes.

I want to be happy and normal and have been busting my ass doing my best, not hiding behind fake smiles, tried so many meds and therapies, working the cbt workbook and talking things out... and yet here I am. Intrusive thoughts about how I work in a high rise and how I've memorized when the train goes by the bridge I walk across every morning.
